conviction_note: Event confirmed (Q3 2026 at 07:00 CEST 15 Oct); the only line with a sign is a probable further appraisal write-down after Norway's 10y yield rose ~39bp in Q3 and Norges Bank hiked on 23 Sep. That is a macro-to-company transmission the market can see itself, and the stock is already down 11% over 60 days at roughly 57% of EPRA NRV, so p_up sits only slightly below 50 (45). Rental income is pre-signalled by the company's own contracted-rent bridge and the H1 dividend falls inside a stated policy. abs_move 3.5 is above the name's 1.5-1.75 median because the period is not pre-released and the last two write-down prints moved -4.1% and -6.9%.

Entra gives no earnings guidance; outlook text only. Unknown.

findings.finding: Q3 appraisals probably carry another negative value change. Norway's 10y government yield rose from 4.207% (30 Jun) to 4.596% (30 Sep) and Norges Bank hiked on 23 Sep. In Q2 the appraisers wrote properties down by NOK 1,094m on 'an adjustment of the external appraisers' estimated required rate of return and exit yields' even while the 10y fell 15bp, and the company's own outlook said the prime yield 'may increase somewhat in the near term'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26, a NOK 1.1bn write-down plus a property-management miss: -4.09% on the day. Q4-24, results 'impacted by' value changes: -6.94%. Q3-25, value changes of -11m: 0.0%.
findings.original_quote: Komiteen besluttet å sette styringsrenten opp fra 4,25 til 4,50 prosent. (Norges Bank, 2026-09-24: the committee decided to raise the policy rate from 4.25 to 4.50 per cent)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The rise in rates is public and the stock fell from 106.6 (15 Jul) to 93.5, trading at about 57% of the last EPRA NRV of 163.29, so the market already marks the portfolio well below the appraisers. What is not public is the size of the appraisers' Q3 yield move and the resulting LTV, which is near 49% against a Moody's Baa3 positive outlook. If that were fully in the price, the stock would not have reacted -4.1% to the Q2 write-down that the same rate backdrop implied.
findings.independence: CBRE Norway Office Market Figures Q2 2026 put the prime office yield 25bp wider at 4.75%, with 5-year swaps around 4.7% in mid-August (https://www.cbre.no/en-gb/insights/figures/norway-office-market-figures-q2-2026, snippet only). Entra's Q2 consensus report raised its prime-yield estimate by 13bp (https://www.entra.no/om-entra/nyheter-presse/entra-konsensusrapport-for-andre-kvartal-2026). Both are proxies; the company has not said Q3 values fell.

findings.finding: The H1 2026 capital distribution will be resolved in this release ('Entra will resolve and communicate dividend for the first half of 2026 in October 2026'). The policy floor of 30% of H1 Cash Earnings of NOK 3.54 implies about NOK 1.06, against NOK 1.10 for H1-25, in cash or a buyback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3-25, which reinstated the dividend at NOK 1.10 under the revised policy: 0.0% on the day. Q4-25, NOK 1.10 plus a 0.5% buyback: +1.75%.
findings.why_not_priced: It sits inside a published policy, so the expected amount is in the price. Only a deviation would move the stock: a skip or deferral to protect LTV near 49% would be negative, and a buyback at 57% of NRV or a payout above the floor would be positive. Nothing sourced points to either, so it is sized at 0.
findings.independence: Dividend policy on the IR page (https://www.entra.no/investor-relations/share-and-analyst-information).

findings.finding: Two new leases were announced in the three sessions before the print: IMDi for about 3,700 sqm at Grensesvingen 7 on a term of over 10 years, and Fellesforbundet for about 1,250 sqm at Storgata 51. Both start in 2027, so they cut into the 229m of vacant-space market rent the Q2 report disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 net letting of 131m, the strongest in years, did not prevent a -4.09% reaction when values and NIFPM disappointed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the leases are public, and the stock rose 1.1% and 1.6% on the two days they were announced. What remains is that the Q4 letting the CEO can cite on the call is already positive, which slightly softens a negative valuation headline.

lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5: the period is not pre-released, and the lesson says not to cap the move on the name's small median reaction (the last two write-down prints moved -4.1% and -6.9%). Kept well below the 7% pooled base because there is no guidance line and turnover is thin on a 23% free float
October leases finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1: 'a finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0', since the leases were public and the stock rose on them

The valuation finding was kept at -0.8: it is macro-to-company transmission, but the company itself attributed the Q2 write-downs to appraiser yields and wrote that yields 'may increase somewhat in the near term', so it was already sized as a proxy and not cut twice
Dividend finding kept at 0, since it lands inside the stated policy
